summary: Explains running Ansible on the control node under Python 3 by installing with pip3, checking with ansible --version, running a source checkout via python3, and notes distro packages are tied to one Python version.
questions: How do I make Ansible run under Python 3 on my control node?
How can I check which Python version Ansible is using?
How do I run Ansible from a source checkout with Python 3?
Why can't my distro-packaged Ansible use a different Python?

answer_card.title: Run Ansible on Python 3 (control node)
answer_card.answer_md:
Install with Python 3's pip and verify:

```shell
pip3 install ansible
ansible --version | grep "python version"
```

From a source checkout, run the tools through `python3`:

```shell
source ./hacking/env-setup
python3 $(which ansible) localhost -m ping
python3 $(which ansible-playbook) sample-playbook.yml
```

Distro packages are built for one Python version; check your distro if you need another.
